# Now, anytime and anywhere
# Active Life is T-ON

ㅤ

# Episode 3 Guam Scenario Update 🎉
# Episodes 1, 2, and 3 are now available together as a unified experience, with no separate DLC!

ㅤ

# Website : https://vr.tioncare.com/
# Discord : https://discord.gg/h7SxDcVV7k
# Youtube : https://www.youtube.com/@official_tion




ㅤ
# Customized workout programs you can only experience at T-ON!
- Choose from a variety of content in three concepts, Adventure, Fitness, and Meditation to enhance your workout enjoyment with the content that suits you best!
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75289915_471515918815664_3189305407806413535_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=QP8XzRLxK1UQ7kNvgHlA7Xf&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD3RWB8fKjf0UYyqw59BH83sIlyukPkfQmH0ul3ULl4Wg&oe=6761421A)

# Adventure with T-ON Friends!
- Adventure mode where you enjoy clearing scenarios and missions with T-ON Friends!


- Comprising a running-focused Activity mode and a turn-based Stage mode, enjoy without boredom and boost your workout effectiveness!
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031607_1009916526948500_2687761705895360872_n.png?_nc_cat=101&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=dnIPHWET6HQQ7kNvgEpae-o&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD3kZLggVkaSerOmeph1S1m3gePr_xti2g2PC2nRtLWeg&oe=676161D0)
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974813_3834557003526053_2648852613662942314_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=WcTaAqKF3boQ7kNvgEcgc-e&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAFbR_ELWQp7KT8u4uR7iSt5zi_i0_2JnVdjt7A2LkbKw&oe=676171B9)

# High-intensity fitness with your personal trainer, KIKI!
- Fitness mode enjoyed with coaching from your personal trainer, KIKI!
- Based on the user's fitness assessment results, the nine customized exercise programs for different physical factors reduce the risk of injury and make workouts more efficient!
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57566689_8264305890275055_163199055515647128_n.png?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=mF9cJVBMIiUQ7kNvgHxuB-S&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA2Ck-zPbOl4nkNOI2WLZfH73fPrPpeUIMSAUHD7SpkrA&oe=676167FD)
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974857_473226988780119_8255524657792333425_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Jeur7fNeL8YQ7kNvgGx6z12&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCWig6tbJgNYmkQO8KdVTwtQ2il1zCudgH-9jGtFjsL8Q&oe=676170A1)

# Cool down meditation for the relaxation of body and mind!
- Meditation mode combining cool-down stretches and mindfulness relaxation after workouts! 
- Embark on a journey to find peace of mind, experiencing the effects of step-by-step meditation against beautiful backdrops such as sunsets, the sea, and campfires
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982695_868676075102674_8045349526861243765_n.png?_nc_cat=103&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=zk9YGG9imFcQ7kNvgFlZHN1&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDO4RQX56wMFvJKR6nse41WCyuyUnJjhOp2g2drYY_RIw&oe=67614915)

0.1.16 Version Update 📢 Hello, dear players! Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product. In this update, we have made the following changes: 
1. Supported Languages: Add Japanese (対応言語:日本語追加)

0.1.15 Version Update 📢 
Hello, dear players! Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product. 
In this update, we have made the following changes: 

1. Added age verification API

2. Updated IARC certification

0.1.14 Version Update 📢 
Hello, dear players! Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product. 
In this update, we have made the following changes: 

1. Bug fixes based on the November 1st release version

2. Fitness Results UI - Workout list modification
(Previously, the same exercise appeared 3 times in a row -> adjusted to display each exercise only once)

3. Fixed issue where users who have not played after purchasing the product could not access the profile scene

0.1.13 Version Update 📢

Hello, dear players!
Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product.

In this update, we have made the following changes:

1. Episode 3: Guam Update
Episode 3: Guam content has finally been updated! 
From the majestic Love's Cliff to the adventure of finding the Health Stones, 
the Guam journey is packed with a variety of exciting challenges and missions waiting for you. 
Log in now to discover new missions and storylines!!🏃‍♂️

2. DLC Integration Service Announcement
Great news! You no longer need to purchase Episode 2: Japan and Episode 3: Guam separately as DLC! 
Both episodes are now integrated, allowing you to enjoy all the content with a single purchase. 
Experience the richness of our unified service!
For those who have already purchased, rest assured—you can still enjoy both Episode 2 and Episode 3 content at no additional cost! 🎉

0.1.12 Version Update 📢

Hello, dear players!
Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product.

In this update, we have made the following changes:

1. The bug preventing profile selection when creating a profile in T-ON VR after signing up for the T-ON CARE app using Google login has been fixed.
Please delete any profiles created before this patch and create a new profile. 😔

2. The bug causing the battle with Minji to not progress smoothly in Adventure Episode 1 - Section 1 has been fixed.

We apologize for the inconvenience and are working to resolve this as quickly as possible.
Thank you for your understanding. 😔

0.1.11 Version Update 📢

Hello, dear players!
Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product.


In this update, we have made the following changes:

1️⃣ General - Added descriptions for opening and closing the settings button when viewing the controller.

2️⃣ General - Improved object element rendering to match the user's field of view distance.

3️⃣ Lobby - Added an automatic workout mode.

4️⃣ Lobby - Added the option to exit T-ON Fitness.

5️⃣ Fitness - Improved the UI position of the fitness measurement point.

6️⃣ Automatic Workout Mode - Added fitness measurement.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused due to some bugs. 😭
Thank you for your understanding.

0.1.10 Version Update 📢

Hello, dear players!
Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product.


In this update, we have made the following changes:

1️⃣ Fixed bug where the profile screen would not proceed when the internet is disconnected.

2️⃣ Fixed bug where fitness sessions in the automatic workout program would not start when the internet is disconnected.

3️⃣ Added system messages for when the internet is disconnected.

4️⃣ Improved resolution of exercise motion icons in Fitness.

5️⃣ Updated user tutorial narration in Adventure.

6️⃣ Displayed the current logged-in user's nickname at the top of the Today's Workout Program UI.

7️⃣ Fixed bug where animations for Adventure, Fitness, and Meditation in the lobby were not applied.


We apologize for any inconvenience caused due to some bugs. 😭
Thank you for your understanding.

0.1.9 Version Update 📢

Hello, dear players!
Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product.

In this update, we have made the following changes:

• Added User Fitness Assessment and 9 Customized Workout Programs 🔥
Check your fitness level through the new assessment program!
Collected fitness and workout data are analyzed by Well-Fit AI to provide 9 personalized workout programs tailored to different fitness goals! 

• Now enjoy with your family too! Multi-profile feature added.👨‍👩‍👦‍👦
Now you can create up to 4 profile accounts!
Enjoy T-ON Fitness with friends, family, and partners!

• Boost the Fun of Exercise!
Clear missions and scenarios in Adventure mode,
collect Health Stones, and enjoy the added excitement of working out! 

Thank you for your understanding.

0.1.8 Version Update 📢

Hello, dear players!
Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product.

In this update, we have made the following changes:

▪ Bug Fix
Fix for abnormal display bug of some buttons when playing with Meta Quest 2 device

Thank you for your understanding.

0.1.5 Version Update 📢

Hello, dear players!
Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product.

In this update, we have made the following changes:

▪ Bug Fix
We discovered a bug where the language setting should default to English when playing outside of South Korea, but it was mixing Korean and English.

We apologize for the inconvenience and will continue to provide better service through ongoing testing and quality control.

Thank you for your understanding.

0.1.4 Version Update 📢

Hello, dear players!
Thank you for your continuous love and enjoyment of our product. 
In this update, we have made the following changes:

1. Bug Fix
- Fix bug with play history when selecting the Adventure section
- Modify title and content text when selecting the Adventure section
